scope: internal HTTP interface for the service layer (Spring Boot); dev, loopback, no browser clients, no CORS; /internal/v1/* requires the shared service key
server: scripts/run_api.py → uvicorn biz_aid_pipeline.api.app:app on 127.0.0.1:8000 (BIZAID_API_PORT), one worker

auth.secret: INTERNAL_AI_API_KEY environment variable (OS env first, then .env.dev); never in code or Git
auth.applies_to: /internal/v1/*; GET /health stays open for local health checks
auth.mismatch: 401 internal_auth_failed; the caller must treat it as a service configuration error, not an end-user login failure

GET /health.rule: no model, DB, Qdrant or LLM call

POST /internal/v1/query.response: service result as returned: SEARCH_LIST {request_mode, status, candidate_count, programs, natural_filter, candidate_period_unknown} or DOCUMENT_QA (RagAnswer fields + request_mode, natural_filter)

POST /internal/v1/eligibility.response: EligibilityService result as returned (contracts/schemas/eligibility.contract.json); status is never recomputed

business_outcomes: NO_CANDIDATES, NO_INDEXED_PROGRAMS, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, NEEDS_MORE_INFO, INELIGIBLE, ELIGIBLE, LISTED, ANSWERED are HTTP 200

errors.502: LLM output violated its contract (filter_extraction_*, eligibility_output_*, invalid evidence/profile field, rag_llm_output_*)
errors.503: llm_unavailable, llm_http_error, MySQL OperationalError, Qdrant connection error (dependency_unavailable); internal_auth_not_configured
errors.500: any other failure (internal_error or other PipelineError code)
errors.rule: no stack trace or connection detail in responses

resources: ServiceRuntime is created once in the FastAPI lifespan: LLM provider, MySQL engine pool and Qdrant client at startup, BGE-M3 Retriever on first use; closed at shutdown; Ollama is external
